packageRules.description: Low-risk updates merge themselves. The repo has no CI, so there are no checks to wait for.

Cilium is pinned to 1.19.7: 1.19.8+ and 1.20.2 need kernel BTF, which the Pi worker kernels lack, and pod networking on those nodes stops (cilium/cilium#48778). See infrastructure/cilium/base/helm-release.yaml.
Flux controllers and CRDs must move together; upgrade by regenerating gotk-components.yaml.
High-impact upgrades only get a PR when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
